description: Watch one Base or Arc wallet for 24 hours ($0.005 on Base) and alert on USDC or gas balance moves. Pass wallet= + chain=base|arc, or id=. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Base only). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
